description.value: Roadhouse is a full-service restaurant in Smithers, BC, operating under the tagline 'comfort food, well travelled' — suggesting creative, satisfying takes on hearty classics. The menu spans weekend brunch (crepes, eggs benny, fried chicken skillets), weekday lunch, and nightly dinner service. A 10-seat private dining room is available for bookings, making it a potential venue for cycling group events.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at roadhouse-smithers.com is live and detailed, confirming the address (3711 Alfred Ave, Smithers, BC V0J 2N0), phone (250-847-2101 — absent from OSM), and that the business is an active sit-down restaurant. Takeout is explicitly offered by phone per the website. Menu pages label multiple dishes as Vegetarian and Vegan. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM name is 'Roadhouse' but website consistently uses 'Roadhouse Smithers' — consider updating the OSM name tag.
OSM had no phone number; 250-847-2101 sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed.phone is null.
OSM community field reads 'Unknown / North Coast & Haida Gwaii' but Smithers is in the Bulkley Valley — directory categorisation may need correction.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, clearly open restaurant in Smithers with a live website, confirmed address, and substantive menu — a solid meal stop for touring cyclists on the Yellowhead corridor.

Takeout.detail: Website states: 'Takeout available over the phone. Please call us at 250-847-2101 to order. Brunch menu not available for takeout. Takeout will be paused during peak times when we are at capacity in the restaurant.'
